text: Your phone can recognise your face, find the fastest route home, and translate a language in seconds. But left completely on its own, it does none of that. A computer is astonishingly fast — yet it has no ideas of its own. It sits and waits to be told exactly what to do, one step at a time. The skill of telling it what to do, so clearly that it never has to guess, is called programming. That single skill is what this entire course is built on.
